sources.title: RJ Harvey ruled OUT for Broncos game vs. Chiefs
sources.description: Terrible news for the Denver Broncos final injury report update with running back RJ Harvey suffering an unknown severity of a knee injury this week and was ruled out for their critical home game against the Kansas City Chiefs on Sunday.
